title: AutonomousWork Project
description: Defines one autonomous project. Each project maps to exactly one target GitHub repository.

id.description: Project ID. Must match its directory name projects/<id>/project.yaml.

repository.description: Exactly one target GitHub repository in Owner/Repo format.

enabled.description: If false, no tasks for this project are executable.

max_active_tasks.description: Max concurrent in_progress tasks for this project.
